rv.q: Witty, revisionist take on a Victorian murder case

Our narrator is “Plume”, a pamphleteer and journalist dedicated, so he says, to exposing the truth. The facts of the case are dealt with in a single brilliant opening number, Penny Dreadful Story, as McGregor and Cooper briskly introduce the characters and their story, to the merry chords of musical director Samuel Macdonald’s onstage parlour...
